subsection: Recent American History and Other Important Historical Information
question_text: What major event happened on September 11, 2001 in the United States?

official_answers.text: Terrorists took over two planes and crashed them into the World Trade Center in New York City
Terrorists took over a plane and crashed into the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia
Terrorists took over a plane originally aimed at Washington, D.C., and crashed in a field in Pennsylvania

why_it_matters.text: On September 11, 2001, 19 al-Qaeda terrorists hijacked four planes. Two struck the World Trade Center towers in New York City. One hit the Pentagon. Nearly 3,000 Americans were killed — the deadliest attack on American soil since the Civil War. The country went to war in Afghanistan within weeks. America was changed forever.

fun_fact.text: On September 11, 2001, four planes were hijacked. The fourth — United Flight 93 — never reached its target. Passengers learned via cell phones what had happened to the other planes, voted to fight back, and stormed the cockpit. The plane crashed in a Shanksville, PA field, 20 minutes from the U.S. Capitol. 40 passengers gave their lives.
